bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 失守 200 日均线，测试 $198–200

read.en: Nvidia fell 3.2% on Nov 4 to $200.13, trading between $199.68 and $206.79 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($205.4), 10-day ($210.0), 30-day ($221.2) and 100-day ($214.5) and the rising 200-day ($204.7) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram roughly steady; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($213.85), and RSI is 34.5.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月4日下跌 3.2%，收于 $200.13，盘中区间 $199.68–206.79，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$205.4）、10 日（$210.0）、30 日（$221.2）和 100 日均线（$214.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$204.7）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图大致持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$213.85），RSI 为 34.5。

read.en: The close lost the 200-day and $204.6 again and broke the $200.9–201.7 support (Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows); the $199.68 low reached the $198–199.3 zone. Resistance is $200.9–201.7, then $204.6–206.8 (200-day, 5-day, Nov 4 high) and $209.1–210 (10-day, Nov 2–3 highs). Support is $198–199.7, then $194.7 (May 4 low) and $189.8–190. A close above $201.7 would target $205–207; below $198, $194.7.

s.en: Nov 4 low $199.68; Jun 9 low $199.34; Jul 17 low $197.97
